ارتضيتن (form VIII)
# اِرْتَضَيْتُنَّ (irtaḍaytunna) /ir.ta.dˤaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
# اُرْتُضِيتُنَّ (urtuḍītunna) /ur.tu.dˤiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِرْتَضَى (irtaḍā)
